svg.title: Orbit architecture: request lifecycle
svg.desc: Client sends a message to context assembly, then an agent loop that calls a retrieval pipeline, then a grounding gate that streams back to the client. A memory writer runs asynchronously after the stream and writes to a SQLite memory store that context assembly reads.
svg.text: Request lifecycle, end to end · the model decides, the harness guarantees

g.text: hot path · blocks the first token
• SQL by date · FTS5 by topic

svg.text: one model · one tool · hard step caps

g.text: • Follows up when evidence is thin

svg.text: code · verifies before the user sees it

g.text: • Page text is data, never orders

svg.text: inside the one tool: web_search(queries[], depth, recency)
→ returns the evidence pack to the agent loop
partial results on timeout · fetched pages are wrapped as untrusted data
small model · after the stream · never blocks

g.text: • Each claim links to the one it
supersedes, so “what changed?” is a diff
• No router call before first token
• Stage 1 is pure code, no LLM call
• Queries fan out in ONE tool call
• Memory writes run after the stream
• Live status, never a silent wait
targets are measured by npm run eval
• Date + memory ride in the user turn
answer model is an env var, picked by eval
• Page text is data, not orders

svg.text: TypeScript · Hono + SSE · React · SQLite (FTS5) · provider-neutral LLM port · Tavily behind a SearchProvider interface
